pharmacology_description:
The action of major ingredients of this preparation-
  • Sana: Keeps stomach clear and helps to prevent skin problems.
  • Revand Chini: Purifies blood, improves liver function and promotes cell repair.
  • Neem: Purifies blood and cures almost every skin disease.
  • Chirata: Purifies blood and keeps it toxin free for better skin conditioning.
  • Tulsi: Improves blood circulation and helps to improve shine on skin.
dosage_description:
Syrup:
  • Adults: 2-4 teaspoonfuls 1-2 time(s) daily.
  • Children: ½-1 teaspoonful 1-2 time(s) daily.
Capsule: 1 capsule 2 times daily. or as prescribed by the registered physician.
side_effects_description: No significant side effect has been observed in therapeutic dosage.
precautions_description: During this treatment, eat slightly less than your appetite demands. Avoid fried, spiced or hard-to-digest foods. Keep out of reach of children. Don’t use the drug after expiry date.
storage_conditions_description: Store in a cool and dry place away from light.
